# Source Data

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Selected compact original numerical and MATLAB source records supplied by the user, retained for provenance. Current simulation uses the organized input/parameter/reference tables.

- [additional muscles](additional_muscles/README.md) — Source architecture and grouping information for additional muscle paths, including toe and forelimb channels. These source records support the applied anatomy in Model_Parameters.
- [forelimb](forelimb/README.md) — Original forelimb parameter, EMG-processing and muscle-grouping records. Forelimb experimental references are from a separate study, not the same trial as the hindlimb recording.
- [hindlimb](hindlimb/README.md) — Original hindlimb walking records, muscle parameters, geometry and inverse-estimated activations. Trial labels identify the source data associated with the supplied model.
